boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented study environments at Saint Norbert College, spanning reservable library rooms, technology-enabled work areas and residence-hall lounges.

cards.entity_name: Miriam B. & James J. Mulva Library
cards.title: Mulva Library
cards.subtitle: 100 Grant Street, De Pere
cards.notes: Start here when your work needs flexible furniture or borrowed cables and equipment; ask the information desk for setup help.
cards.short_summary: The campus library combines bookable areas, flexible furnishings and technology support.
cards.evidence_claim: Mulva Library states that most areas offer flexible furniture and varying technology, and that equipment may be borrowed from the information desk.
cards.access_notes: The library says it is open to the public. Book a space through the campus room-reservation system.

cards.title: Mulva Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Inside Mulva Library
cards.notes: Bring a project group and use a designated group-study room; confirm the room’s availability or reservation requirements before arriving.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated group-study rooms within the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert’s campus tour guide lists group study rooms among the spaces in Mulva Library.
cards.source_title: Saint Norbert College Campus Tour Guide Script
cards.access_notes: The library directs users to its campus room-reservation system to book spaces.

cards.title: Mulva Library Reflection Lounge
cards.subtitle: Inside Mulva Library
cards.notes: Choose this library reflection lounge when you want a quieter pause between reading and drafting; keep the visit focused and low-key.
cards.short_summary: A designated reflection-oriented space in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert’s campus tour guide identifies a reflection lounge in Mulva Library.
cards.source_title: Saint Norbert College Campus Tour Guide Script
cards.access_notes: Check Mulva Library’s current hours and any space-use guidance before visiting.

cards.title: Mulva Library Practice Presentation Room
cards.subtitle: Inside Mulva Library
cards.notes: Use this room to rehearse slides or a talk aloud before class; confirm access and reservation details through the library first.
cards.short_summary: A designated room for practicing presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert’s College Jumpstart handbook lists a practice presentation room among Mulva Library’s student study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Confirm room availability with the library or through its room-reservation system.

cards.title: Ed’s Coffee Shop Study Area
cards.subtitle: First floor, Mulva Library
cards.notes: Pair a short reading session with the first-floor café setting, then move to another library area if you need a quieter environment.
cards.short_summary: A café-and-study area located in Mulva Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert’s College Jumpstart handbook identifies a café and study area in Mulva Library, while the campus tour guide places Ed’s Coffee Shop on the first floor.
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks are sold at the coffee shop; verify current service and library access details before visiting.

cards.title: Mulva Studio
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Mulva Library
cards.notes: Use the lower-level studio when your assignment benefits from collaborative workspace, recording capability or photo-studio equipment.
cards.short_summary: A technology-enabled collaborative workspace in the library’s lower level.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert’s virtual tour describes the Mulva Studio as a collaborative workspace, recording studio and photo studio on Mulva Library’s lower level.
cards.access_notes: Located in Mulva Library; check library hours and any equipment or space-reservation requirements.

cards.title: Mulva Library Basement Mac Computers
cards.subtitle: Basement, Mulva Library
cards.notes: Use a basement Mac when your task needs Adobe Creative Cloud, Microsoft 365, Zoom or a library desktop rather than your own device.
cards.short_summary: A library computer area with current software support documentation.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert’s service desk documents two Mac computers in the Mulva Library basement with Google Chrome, Microsoft 365, Zoom and Adobe Creative Cloud.
cards.source_title: What software is available on the library and lab computers?
cards.access_notes: Computer availability is not guaranteed; use during current library access hours.

cards.entity_name: John A. Phillips ’66 Family Study Room
cards.title: John A. Phillips ’66 Family Study Room
cards.subtitle: Gehl-Mulva Science Center
cards.notes: Set up by the window for focused science-course reading or problem sets, then check locally whether the room has current access controls.
cards.short_summary: A named study room in the science center.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert identifies the John A. Phillips ’66 Family Study Room as a study room within the Gehl-Mulva Science Center and notes its window location.
cards.source_title: 2015: A Landmark Year in College History
cards.access_notes: Confirm current room availability and access procedures with the Gehl-Mulva Science Center.

cards.entity_name: Gehl-Mulva Science Center Informal Collaborative Spaces
cards.title: Gehl-Mulva Informal Collaborative Spaces
cards.subtitle: Gehl-Mulva Science Center
cards.notes: Use the center’s informal collaborative areas for a science-team work session, especially when you need to stay near faculty offices.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative study areas positioned near faculty offices in the science center.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert reports that Gehl-Mulva Science Center includes study rooms and informal collaborative spaces near faculty offices.
cards.source_title: 2015: A Landmark Year in College History
cards.access_notes: Access may depend on building operations; verify current entry and room-use expectations locally.

cards.entity_name: Mary Minahan McCormick Hall Study Lounge
cards.title: MMM Hall Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: First floor, Mary Minahan McCormick Hall
cards.notes: If you live in MMM Hall, use its renovated first-floor study lounge for a nearby focused session without leaving the residence hall.
cards.short_summary: A renovated study lounge within Mary Minahan McCormick Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert’s residential education page states that Mary Minahan McCormick Hall has one large renovated study lounge on its first floor.
cards.source_title: Residential Education and Housing — Living Options
cards.access_notes: This is in a residence hall; access is intended for hall residents and their permitted guests.
